profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
My journey into the world of programming began with a strong background in technology, having been lucky enough to receive my first desktop computer at the age of five. However, it wasn't until 2020, driven by my interest in cryptocurrencies, that I truly discovered my passion for software development. Over the past four years, I've been dedicated to improving my skills, starting as a self-taught developer and later advancing through formal experience at NewForce. Since the day that I began, programming has been my favorite hobby and primary creative outlet. Most of my free time is spent working on personal projects. 

I also hold a Bachelor's degree in Business Management and I have experience both working with teams and managing teams in tech-oriented environments. Whether it's through personal projects or professional endeavors, I am driven by a deep passion for coding and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement. This blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and leadership experience allows me to bring a well-rounded, team-oriented approach to software development.

positions.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Intensive full-time 6-month software development immersive training program focusing on full stack (C#/.NET) development fundamentals and problem solving. The final half of the program is executed in a simulated company environment with Scrum methodology.

-Applied object-oriented programming fundamentals through team-based projects that reflect real world business problems
-Collaborated remotely on projects using Slack and Zoom
-Managed source code version control with Git/ GitHub
-Applied JavaScript, HTML, and CSS fundamentals to build a feature-rich social media dashboard
-Leveraged native ES6 module bundling to build DRY, reusable components
-Designed and built single-page applications with React using Hooks
-Designed applications through white boarding dependencies and building ERD’s
-Built and interacted with databases using SQL and ADO.NET
-Developed a blog management platform in ASP.NET, MVC, and Razor templates in Visual Studio 2019
-Created RESTful Web API with C#/ .NET Core and connected it to a React
front-end
-Built and maintained integration tests in .NET Core

projects.title: ljwhite.is - 3D Personal Portfolio App
projects.description:
https://www.ljwhite.is/

My personal portfolio app, made to be an interactive 3D scene (my office if it was in space). It has Red Bull, a Bitcoin ATM, and electronic dance music. What more could one want? Made with NextJS and utilizes React Three Fiber, React Three Drei, React Three Rapier, THREE.js, and more. Eventually it will contain more info on projects I have worked on, more interactivity,  multiple scenes, and other optimizations.

projects.title: Lotta - Loyalty Programs on Blockchain
projects.description:
Allows entities to create, deploy, and manage customizable loyalty program smart contracts on the blockchain of their choice and optionally reward their users with cryptocurrency. Features a NextJS dashboard where entities can manage their loyalty programs for use on their own apps or websites. It also includes the smart contracts themselves - a contract factory and 3 escrow contract modules that cover 3 prominent ERC token standards as well as a REST API to aid in external use of the entities' smart contracts.

For the NextJS user dashboard, this project utilizes T3 stack (TypeScript, Tailwind, TRPC) (https://create.t3.gg/). It also utilizes Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL and NextAuth.js. Other useful packages I have used for this include: Zustand, Zod, node-forge.

For blockchain integrations, I used Solidity language to create the smart contracts and have used both Truffle and HardHat development environments to compile, deploy, and unit test the smart contracts. This project also utilizes the following packages to facilitate user interaction with the crypto aspects:
Ethers.js, WAGMI, RainbowKit, Moralis, Viem, Circle Financial.

Some of the screenshots below have been taken over time and may not be up to date as I am still working on this project - some visual items are placeholders.

More details and higher quality screenshots can be seen here: https://github.com/theljwhite/loyalty
